# QS-CFW-5010-61 - Quality specification - axle hub CFW-5010-61 (4140)

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-5010-61

## Scope
This quality specification applies to the axle hub CFW-5010-61 (CFW-5010-61) forged from material grade 4140 and processed at Plant P3. It defines acceptance criteria for hardness, bore dimensional tolerance, and maximum forging weight, and establishes inspection and nonconformance handling requirements for delivered parts.

## Requirements table

| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 4140 (forged condition) |
| Hardness | The hardness range for axle hub CFW-5010-61 (CFW-5010-61) is 22-28 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for axle hub CFW-5010-61 (CFW-5010-61) is ±0.10 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for axle hub CFW-5010-61 (CFW-5010-61) is 5.4 kg. |

## Inspection method
- Hardness: Verify hardness on representative locations per part using a calibrated Rockwell C tester. Report measured values and verify they fall within the specified hardness range for axle hub CFW-5010-61 (CFW-5010-61). Maintain calibration records for the hardness tester.
- Bore diameter: Measure bore diameter with a calibrated bore gauge or internal micrometer. Record measured diameters and check deviation against the bore diameter tolerance for axle hub CFW-5010-61 (CFW-5010-61). Use appropriate fixturing to ensure repeatable measurement orientation.
- Weight: Confirm forging weight using a calibrated scale. Record measured weight and confirm compliance with the maximum forging weight for axle hub CFW-5010-61 (CFW-5010-61).
- Sampling: Inspections shall be performed on parts selected across the process flow to verify consistency. All inspection data shall be recorded in the part inspection record and retained per Plant P3 document control practices.

## Nonconformance handling
- Any part failing to meet the hardness, bore diameter tolerance, or maximum forging weight requirements shall be segregated and identified as nonconforming.
- Document nonconformance in the plant nonconformance record and initiate containment to prevent further use.
- Root cause analysis shall be performed and corrective action implemented prior to release of additional parts.
- Disposition of nonconforming material shall be documented and approved by quality authority in Plant P3.
